about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME

Wake up on a deserted island with no memory of how you got there. Speedrun through compact coin-farming stages, dodging traps and solving quick challenges while a dark Echo replays your exact moves and hunts you down. Spend the daytime back at your island base to craft, prepare, and live because when night falls, the Shadows come to raid.

GAME MODE

Echooo! Don’t Get Stepped is an adventure-sim game built around a satisfying two-part loop:

1) RUN – Farm coins in bite-sized stages
Sprint through short stages to collect magical coins, overcome obstacles, and outplay an Echo that copies your run (a true replay of your actions).

2) LIVE & DEFEND – Return to your island base
During the day, you’re free to prepare: craft gear, build defenses, eat coconuts, dig, fish, and interact in your small island hub. When night arrives, your base is under attack use what you earned to survive the raid. The fun is in your choices: push for a better run to earn more, or spend precious daylight strengthening your defenses before the next night.

3) ARCADE - Don’t Fall is a score-driven arcade mode built around pure movement and quick reactions. The rule is simple: don’t fall below.

KEY FEATURE

  • Race your own Echo 
    a shadow that replays your movements and turns every run into a personal challenge

  • Speedrun coin-farming stages 
    short, replayable levels with varied obstacles and pacing

  • Island hub with freedom in the daytime 
    craft, prepare, and do light survival activities between runs

  • Night raids 
    build and upgrade defenses to protect your base when the Shadows attack

  • Story prologue that unfolds 
    uncover why you’re trapped here, and what your Echo really is

WHAT'S IN THE DEMO

This demo is the Island Prologue. You’ll experience:

  • the core speedrun coin-farming stages and the Echo chase

  • returning to base to craft and prepare

  • a slice of daytime island activities

  • an ending tease that hints at a much larger journey beyond the island

Wishlist now to follow development and future updates new content, new systems, and new locations.
